description: Operational health of the IPAFFS AKS cluster: node capacity, workload stability and resource usage. Prometheus-only; environment-agnostic via the datasource and cluster variables.

panels.description: Nodes currently reporting Ready. Compare with Nodes Total.
panels.title: Nodes Ready

panels.description: Pods stuck in Pending or Failed phase. Anything above 0 needs a look.
panels.title: Pods Pending / Failed

panels.description: Deployments where available replicas do not match the desired count.
panels.title: Degraded Deployments

panels.description: Pods whose last container termination was an OOM kill. See the OOMKilled table below for details.

targets.expr: count(sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="$cluster",reason="OOMKilled"})) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Pods OOMKilled (last state)

panels.description: Highest filesystem usage per node, excluding tmpfs/overlay.
panels.title: Node Disk Usage (worst filesystem)

panels.description: Container restarts per pod. Empty when nothing is restarting.
panels.title: Pod Restarts

panels.description: Containers stuck waiting (CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ...). Empty when the cluster is healthy.
panels.title: Problem Pods (waiting containers)

panels.description: All deployments with desired vs ready replicas. Degraded ones sort to the top with the Missing count highlighted.
panels.title: Deployment Replicas (Desired vs Ready)

panels.description: Containers whose most recent termination was an OOM kill. Consider raising memory limits.
panels.title: OOMKilled Containers (last termination)

panels.description: Solid lines: CPU cores in use. Dashed lines: CPU requested.
panels.title: CPU Usage by Namespace (vs requests)

panels.description: Solid lines: working set memory in use. Dashed lines: memory requested.
panels.title: Memory (working set) by Namespace (vs requests)

panels.description: Percentage of CPU periods throttled, per pod (only pods above 5% shown). Sustained throttling means CPU limits are too low.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster="$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100 > 5

panels.title: CPU Throttling by Pod

title: IPAFFS_AKS_Ops
